items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: was another girl I had in the other band... And this girl named Lilly Labourney

ctx.x: was another girl I had in the other band, because I had to organize another band from the same man that owned the Sweethearts, to make money, and use the two bands.
And this girl named Lilly Labourney, she there now, and she's as great as any man you ever want to hear in your life.
Wasn't there somebody named Anna Mae Winbone or something?
